user.title: Biamp Tesira
user.description: Enter the Tesira's control-network address. It speaks the Tesira Text Protocol on TCP port 23 with no authentication. The running design is read from the device on the next step.

design.title: Confirm the DSP design
design.description: Read {count} controllable block(s) from the device. Edit or trim the list, then submit. Each entry is `{{"tag": "instanceTag", "kind": "kind", ...}}` - kinds: aecinput, input, meter, level, mute (take `channels`); standardmixer, matrixmixer (take `inputs` and `outputs`). {error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tesira over TTP. Check the IP and that port 23 is open.
error.cannot_discover: Connected, but no controllable blocks were found in the running design.

init.title: DSP design
init.description: A JSON list of the DSP blocks to expose, each `{{"tag": "instanceTag", "kind": "kind", ...}}`. Kinds: aecinput, input, meter, level, mute (all take `channels`); standardmixer, matrixmixer (take `inputs` and `outputs`). Find instance tags in Tesira software (right-click a block, then Properties), or tick "Re-discover from device" to pull the current design over TTP. {error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tesira over TTP.
error.cannot_discover: Connected, but no controllable blocks were found in the running design.
